name: Operational Agents
tagline: Carry out bounded work with approved tools and evidence of the result.
customer_outcome: A team can control an agent's tool execution, approve exact changes, and recover interrupted work without repeating effects blindly.
decision_prompts: Which task is bounded enough to delegate, and when must the agent stop?
Which live facts and tool permissions does the task need?
Where does task state belong, and what must survive a restart?
Who approves an exact change, and how will the system reject stale approval?
How will an operator determine whether an interrupted operation committed?

lessons.title: Choose and verify the execution foundation
Prove behavior and prepare to operate

build_modules.title: Define scope and refusal
build_modules.summary: Bind a task to explicit record IDs and reject requests outside that scope.
build_modules.outcome: An out-of-scope request fails without changing a record.

build_modules.title: Connect the execution environment
build_modules.summary: Connect the customer's runtime to an approved model and tool API. Use local checks only for reference behavior.
build_modules.outcome: The runtime can authenticate to the required services and rejects denied access.

build_modules.title: Connect narrow tool operations
build_modules.summary: Implement the customer's read and proposal adapters with destination authorization and version checks.
build_modules.outcome: The connected operation rejects invalid arguments and duplicate-operation conflicts.

build_modules.title: Persist task progress
build_modules.summary: Keep task progress in the customer's durable application store, separate from live records.
build_modules.outcome: Pending approval and prior evidence survive a runtime restart.

build_modules.title: Enforce execution limits
build_modules.summary: Apply persisted call and time budgets around the shared execution loop.
build_modules.outcome: Exhausted work stops instead of receiving a fresh budget on resume.

build_modules.title: Bind approval to a proposal
build_modules.summary: Require a separate operator decision tied to the task, exact arguments, and expected record version.
build_modules.outcome: Only an unchanged approved proposal can reach the write boundary.

build_modules.title: Reconcile interrupted operations
build_modules.summary: Interrupt the process around a tool commit and look up the operation before deciding what happened.
build_modules.outcome: A committed operation is recovered once; an unproven result stays unresolved.

build_modules.title: Deliver and hand over the connected task
build_modules.summary: Test through the customer's user channel, inspect destination evidence, and rehearse recovery with the operating owner.
build_modules.outcome: A deployed scoped task with customer acceptance evidence and an operating owner.
